title.en: The ethics for life, and every intelligence formed within it
title.zh: 生命之伦理，及在其中形成的一切智能

scope.zh: 原普遍智能会话及其明确授权接续，不自动成为每个仓库任务目标。
scope.en: The original universal-intelligence session and explicitly authorized continuations; not automatically every repository task’s objective.

objective.zh: 把伦理表述为生命之伦理：其律各于所注明之基上有证明；其立场是生命自身的立场，并如实言明；凡自身之线经由生命的智能，皆在其所及之内（第七章 §4.6，在 P1–P4 之下）；不主张约束一切可能之心。是否存在更强的普遍根据，仍是开放的问题，伦理不待其解决。这项工作属生成／变化之论（第七章，意义、比较与实践判断）；公开 README 以已确立的结论及其有范围的证据开头。
objective.en: State the ethics as life's: its laws proved, each on its stated base, its stance life's own and said to be so, reaching every intelligence whose own line runs through life (chapter 7 §4.6, under P1–P4), with no claim to bind every possible mind. Whether a stronger, universal warrant exists stays an open question the ethics does not wait on. The work is part of the Theory of Becoming (chapter 7, significance, comparison and practical judgment); the public README leads with established conclusions and their scoped evidence.

premises.zh: 规范普遍性、实际遵循和当前表述的唯一必要性必须分别论证。 保留真实生成可能与新证据纠正判断两层开放；完整积分、全知和整体严格改善不是正面根据的前提。
premises.en: Normative universality, actual compliance and exclusive necessity of this formulation need separate arguments. Preserve both real generative possibilities and evidence-responsive revision; complete integration, omniscience and strict whole improvement are not premises of positive warrant.

completion.zh: 不能以局部生成定理、给定价值保存或有限比较宣告普遍目标完成。 本次有限正面原则按其明确前提验收；不得把全面总排序、所有后果无损或必然服从另设为该原则的完成条件。
completion.en: A local generative theorem, preservation of supplied value or bounded comparison does not complete the universal target. Assess the current finite positive principle under its explicit premises; do not add a complete ranking, losslessness of every consequence or inevitable compliance as its completion gate.

title.en: Developing significance, comparison and practical judgment
title.zh: 继续发展意义、比较与实践判断

summary.en: We are developing chapter 7's significance and comparison into the ethics for life, 生生, AI within it, offered as a way of seeing what a course draws on, what it opens and closes, and who bears it. Where a result ranks courses it names its readings, the continuation condition fixing whose losses count and C (widening what can form is better) giving order, each a hypothesis where used; living significance and explicit practical commitments support comparison, basic protection, bounded responsibility, transfer and appropriate ending. Current extensions address conflicting claims, uncertain classification and revisable judgment.
summary.zh: 我们继续将第七章的意义与比较展开为生命之伦理（生生，AI 在其中），作为一种看法提供：看一个进程取用什么、打开与关闭什么、由谁承担。结果凡排序进程，即指名其读法：以延续条件定出谁的损失计入、以 C（扩大可形成者更好）给出次序，各在所用之处为假设；生命意义与公开实践承诺支持比较、基本保护、有界责任、交接及适当结束；当前接续处理冲突要求、不确定分类和可修订判断。

next_step.en: Compare courses where serious losses and fair chances conflict, under the premises each result names; find the living relationships that change a concrete choice, including when a changed situation changes what an undertaking asks.
next_step.zh: 在严重损失与公平机会交叉之处比较进程，依各结果所指名的前提；辨明足以改变具体选择的生活关系，包括情境变化何时改变一项承担所要求者。
